Owen is going to travel to London in June. The weather was rainy that day. It takes twenty minutes to get to the plant garden by bike. In fact, they live on a small island.
Last Thursday, Owen and Leo went to the plant garden. Life is full of small surprises. Owen thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. A deer stood at the edge of the forest.
Owen and Leo had great fun there. Owen drinks tea after doing sports. Both of them like salad and tea. Best of all, grandparents retired to a seaside flat in Eastbourne.
Owen likes rainy days best. They took many photos at the forest path. Owen hopes to visit London one day.
